LAGOS STATE (PSI 9.1): Lagos Unveils 3,000MW Power Plan by March 2027; LASEPA Drives Oil & Gas Compliance

ENUGU STATE (PSI 8.8): Governor Mbah Secures $200M (₦300B) Solar Investment for 100MW Enugu Power Project
KATSINA STATE (PSI 8.7): Katsina Ranks #1 in National Climate Governance; Showcases Revenue Model at World Bank Forum
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 8.6): Zamfara Deploys Digital Geo-Fencing for Grazing Reserves; Advances Anti-Banditry & E-Zakat Tech
OGUN STATE (PSI 8.5): Governor Abiodun Expands Education Support to 1,277 Beneficiaries; Introduces Digital Skills Grants
ONDO STATE (PSI 8.4): Ondo Signs $362M PPP Agreement for West Africa's First Integrated Titanium Processing Plant
RIVERS STATE (PSI 8.3): Governor Fubara Reaffirms Military Support; Welcomes New Army Brigade Sited in Ahoada
EDO STATE (PSI 8.2): Edo Distributes 100 Mobile Science Labs to Schools; Supplies Free Fertiliser to Disabled Farmers
DELTA STATE (PSI 8.1): Governor Oborevwori Commissions Oghareki Modern Technical College; Grants ₦50M Support
SOKOTO STATE (PSI 8.0): Governor Ahmed Aliyu Receives Fire Assessment Report; Assures Relief for 76 Verified Victims
KADUNA STATE (PSI 7.9): Kaduna SUBEB Clears Promotion Backlog for 24,000 Teachers; USSEF Launches Health Outreach
ABIA STATE (PSI 7.8): Ukwa-Ngwa Appointees Reaffirm Support for Governor Otti; CPS Clarifies Civil Service Payroll Audit
ANAMBRA STATE (PSI 7.7): Governor Soludo Addresses TEDxEnugu; Approves FG/ASUU Agreement for COOU Staff
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 7.6): Plateau Ministry Inspects LGA Projects; Announces PLAGIS Title Recertification Drive
AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 7.5): Governor Umo Eno Meets 31 LGA Chairmen; Reviews Oron Maritime Ferry Progress
BENUE STATE (PSI 7.3): Governor Alia Commends NAF Professionalism Following Anti-Kidnapping Close Air Support
FCT ABUJA (PSI 7.1): Minister Wike Declares Teachers' Strike Political; Enforces 'No Work, No Pay' Rule
GOMBE STATE (PSI 7.0): Gombe Specialist Hospital Holds Drug Revolving Fund Training to Sustain Medicine Supply
BAYELSA STATE (PSI 6.8): Governor Diri Imposes 24-Hour Curfew on Biseni Community Following Security Unrest

ADAMAWA (PSI 9.2): SSG Hon. Awwal D. Tukur launched Adamawa 2.0 Civil Service ERP Digitization to unify personnel records; inspected solar street lights at Malkohi Estate; granted vocational kits to 300 StaR project graduates.

LAGOS (PSI 9.1): Gov Sanwo-Olu unveiled a 7-point plan at LBS Energy Conference to boost power supply to 3,000MW by March 2027; LASEPA held Oil & Gas Stakeholders' Forum; LSCAC held traditional leadership workshop.
CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.9): Gov Otu presented 15 electric cars to state magistrates; Education Ministry partnered with UNFPA on TVET life-skills M&E workshop; hosted 82nd BON General Assembly in Calabar.
ENUGU (PSI 8.8): Gov Mbah secured $200M solar investment with Eauxwell Nigeria for 100MW distributed solar generation with battery storage, urging tariff review and fast delivery.
KATSINA (PSI 8.7): Emerged #1 state in 2026 Subnational Climate Governance Ranking (SCGPRR 3.0); Gov Radda showcased Katsina's ₦50B to ₦104B capital spending surge at World Bank Forum in Abuja.

ZAMFARA (PSI 8.6): ZACPC and ZAGIS partnered to geo-fence 36 grazing reserves; Gov Lawal deployed drones and Tsafe-Yankuzo road against bandits; Zakat Board launched e-collections; SACAPHTA trained 40 staff.

OGUN (PSI 8.5): Gov Abiodun expanded education support to 1,277 students across 9 LGAs, launching UTME/SSCE WhatsApp revision, ₦250k start-up grants for technical graduates, and digital tech skills training.
ONDO (PSI 8.4): Signed $362M PPP with PyVee Ltd for West Africa's first integrated titanium plant in Ilaje LGA, taking land equity to process ilmenite ore locally for US aerospace supply chains.
RIVERS (PSI 8.3): Gov Fubara received new 6 Div Garrison Commander Brig. Gen. Sule, pledging sustained oil asset security support and welcoming the creation of a new Army Brigade in Ahoada.

EDO (PSI 8.2): Distributed 100 mobile science laboratories to secondary schools across 3 senatorial districts; Ministry of Agriculture provided free fertiliser to 100+ profiled farmers with disabilities.
DELTA (PSI 8.1): Gov Oborevwori commissioned Oghareki Technical College in Oghara, announcing three more technical colleges near completion and granting ₦50M educational support to Davina Orenovo.
SOKOTO (PSI 8.0): Gov Ahmed Aliyu received committee report on Sokoto Central motor park and Old Market fire outbreaks, promising financial assistance to 76 verified victims to resume business.
KADUNA (PSI 7.9): Kaduna SUBEB commenced promotion exercise for 24,000 teachers covering 2021-2026 backlogs; USSEF launched Phase 2 free medical/surgical outreach in Sanga LGA.

ABIA (PSI 7.8): Ukwa-Ngwa appointees issued 10-point endorsement of Gov Otti; CPS Ukoha clarified civil service payroll audit, debunking '15,000 sacked' claims by detailing 2023 backdoor employment fraud.
ANAMBRA (PSI 7.7): Gov Soludo urged Igbo economic investment at TEDxEnugu; spoke at Gen. Obiakor memorial; approved full implementation of 2025 FG/ASUU Agreement for COOU university staff.
PLATEAU (PSI 7.6): Local Gov Ministry inspected council projects in Kanam, Kanke, and Pankshin; Lands Commissioner Gwom announced systematic land title recertification and ₦8B PLAGIS revenue target.
AKWA IBOM (PSI 7.5): Gov Umo Eno hosted 31 LGA Chairmen on 2nd anniversary; reviewed transport projects, announcing Oron Maritime Infrastructure and Ferry Project is 85% complete alongside CNG buses.
BENUE (PSI 7.3): Gov Alia commended Air Force close air support against kidnappers in Ogbadigbo LGA and praised pilot's professional discretion during precautionary landing near Makurdi.
FCT ABUJA (PSI 7.1): Minister Wike declared NLC teachers' strike political, enforcing 'no work, no pay'; ordered immediate dismantling of unauthorized beer parlors along Guzape-Asokoro axis.
GOMBE (PSI 7.0): Gombe Specialist Hospital and DRMA organized a 1-day training on Drug Revolving Fund operations to ensure continuous availability of essential medicines.
BAYELSA (PSI 6.8): Gov Douye Diri imposed an immediate 24-hour curfew on Biseni community in Yenagoa LGA following road blockades and breakdown of law and order.
